'''Harn''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] employed by [[Osaji Varane]]. Serving Varane as his personal secretary and majordomo, Harn surrendered when Varane was apprehended and killed. In exchange for his life, he gave the killers information on the whereabouts of [[Osaji Uhares]].
